description: Contract fixtures for AUT-519. numberOrigin=published rows reproduce BMF arithmetic and are the only independent numeric checks. numberOrigin=synthetic rows are ACP illustrations for the 2024 slice; independentValidation is false and they do not prove the tariff. Money fields are JSON numbers, matching NovaCalculateResponseDto.novaAmountEuro. Compare money with roundMoneyEuro on both sides. valueDevelopmentFactor.numerator and valueDevelopmentFactor.denominator are JSON numbers in both modes. A 422 body has code and message only and must not include novaAmountEuro. A 400 body is the global ValidationPipe rejection and is not a slice code.
